title: Data Engineer
description:
GCP DATA ENGINEER£100,000 + 30% Bonus
LONDON

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing insurtech business undertaking a major cloud data transformation. You'll play a key role in building a new Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data platform, taking ownership across ingestion, transformation and data modelling while helping shape the future of the engineering function.

THE COMPANY

Our client is an established insurtech business operating within the home insurance market, specialising in more complex insurance requirements, including non-standard properties, high-value contents and specialist risks.

Backed by significant private equity investment, the business continues to invest heavily in technology, data, machine learning and predictive analytics.

With an ambitious growth strategy and an expanding engineering function, this is an opportunity to join a business where data is central to its continued development.

THE ROLE

  • Build and scale a new GCP data platform, contributing to its architecture and ongoing development

  • Support the migration of existing data workloads from Azure to Google Cloud

  • Design and develop robust, scalable data ingestion pipelines and frameworks

  • Build transformation layers and semantic data models using dbt or Dataform

  • Take ownership across the full data engineering lifecycle, from ingestion through to deployment

  • Develop cloud-native data solutions using Python and SQL

  • Improve platform performance, scalability and engineering standards

  • Work closely with senior engineers and the wider team to deliver critical data initiatives

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years' experience in Data Engineering

  • 2-3+ years' hands-on experience working extensively with GCP

  • Strong Python and SQL development skills

  • Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines

  • Strong data modelling experience

  • Commercial experience with dbt, although Dataform will also be considered

  • Experience delivering end-to-end data engineering solutions

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach

  • Streaming, real-time processing, infrastructure or GCP certifications would be advantageous

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • £80,000-£100,000 base salary

  • 30% bonus

  • Hybrid working (1 day per week)

  • Opportunity to work on a greenfield GCP platform build

  • Significant investment in data and technology

  • Opportunity to influence platform architecture and engineering best practices

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV through to Harry Lack via the 'Apply' link.
